title: Positive hypnotic suggestions to reduce anxiety and improve weaning success in prolonged weaning patients
summary: More and more patients have a hard time to breathe on their own after an intubation. In a spontaneous breathing session, patients are often anxious, which keeps them from getting independent of ventilation. In our study, we accompany patients in a spontaneous breathing session with hypnosis and positive suggestions to reduce their anxiety and increase their well-being.

interventions.name: Prolonged weaning patients accompanied with hypnosis and positive suggestions during a spontaneous breathing attempt
Prolonged weaning patients during a spontaneous breathing attempt

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Prolonged weaning (3 failed spontaneous breathing sessions)
Fear of weaning
Exclusion criteria:
Low compliance for the intervention
Hearing loss
High sedation medication
Too low cognitive attention
